newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish police wish drivers a sober Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Irish police wish drivers a sober Christmas.

text.p: Irish police are to put up 41,000 check points this Christmas to discourage drunk driving.
"You will be a lucky man or woman if you get through those if you are driving and you have taken a drink," Deputy Police Commissioner P.J. Moran said in a statement.
Moran said the number of checkpoints to be mounted during the eight-week Christmas period was unprecedented and chances of getting caught for drunk driving were "very, very high indeed"
